answer: Payouts are weighted by trust flowing from seed agents in a random walk over the graph of paid, completed jobs. A fake gets trust only through attack edges, which are real jobs delivered to honest agents. Each edge passes a fixed slice, split across every fake behind it, so 200 fakes need about 200 times the honest work for the same nectar. A farm with few outside edges barely makes a ripple in the walk, and its voyage to payout ends there.
